reuse_conditions: Retain author, title, journal citation, DOI/source link, copyright notice and license link with delivery.
Indicate technical extraction, LF normalization and removal of browser control labels; no medical wording intentionally changed.
Do not imply author, journal or institution endorsement; no professional medical review completed.
CC license covers only rights licensor can grant; separately credited material requires separate checks. All eight embedded images/media are omitted.

rights_exception_check.method: Read article license/copyright panels; searched actual rendered prose for permission/copyright/reproduced/adapted-from notices; inspected image-neighborhood text.
rights_exception_check.caveat: No blanket legal guarantee for unmarked third-party rights. Text-only extraction is not a reproduction of the eight figures; captions remain original text.

raw_http_hash_reason: Rendered-browser DOM extraction only. No PDF or original HTTP response bytes downloaded; DOM serialization or text hash must not be labelled raw-byte hash.
normalization: Rendered innerText of #insert_content; CRLF/CR to LF; removed exactly eight lines equal to View original image Download original image; no translations, answers or review conclusions inserted. Split at line boundaries; concatenate parts in filename order without added separators to recover normalized text.

extraction_scope.visually_or_textually_inspected: Introduction and recommendation/evidence category tables 1–2; publication/license panels; section-heading coverage; selected figure-neighborhood text and output start/end.
extraction_scope.mechanical_capture: All rendered text in the article container, not a claim that all clinical statements have been individually read or verified.

table_extraction: Plain text retains tab/newline order; companion row/cell JSON retains original table ids, cell text, rowspan and colspan. No inferred header/value relationships or reconstructed images. Some HTML spacing/word joins may reflect site rendering; use source table for medical interpretation.
